metadata.title: OpenEconomy prototype
metadata.warning: Prototype values are illustrative unless explicitly replaced by reported public-source facts. Do not use them as official statistics.

sources.name: National Economic Accounts and Input-Output Accounts
sources.note: Intended source for production, income, consumption, compensation, trade, and industry flows.

sources.name: Financial Accounts of the United States (Z.1)
sources.note: Intended source for financial stocks and inter-sector financial flows.

sources.name: EDGAR / Company Facts
sources.note: Intended source for named public-company financial statement facts.

sources.name: Business and labor statistics
sources.publisher: U.S. Census Bureau and Bureau of Labor Statistics
sources.note: Intended source for payroll, employment, establishments, and labor-market detail.

sources.name: Federal campaign finance data
sources.note: Intended source for federal contributions, committee receipts, disbursements, and independent expenditures.

entities.name: Households
entities.description: People and household units receiving income, consuming, saving, paying taxes, and making political contributions.

entities.name: Firms
entities.description: Nonfinancial businesses producing goods and services and paying workers and suppliers.

entities.name: Government
entities.description: Federal, state, and local governments collecting taxes and purchasing goods and services or paying transfers.

entities.name: Retirement Funds
entities.description: Retirement accounts and pension vehicles receiving contributions and owning financial assets.

entities.name: Rest of World
entities.description: Foreign households, firms, governments, and financial institutions trading with the U.S.

entities.name: PACs & Super PACs
entities.description: Political committees receiving contributions and making campaign-related expenditures.

entities.name: Media & Campaign Vendors
entities.description: Media outlets, ad platforms, consultants, printers, and other vendors paid by campaigns and committees.

entities.name: Public Companies
entities.description: Publicly traded firms that can be progressively resolved using SEC filings.

entities.name: Other / Unresolved Firms
entities.description: Explicit residual for business activity not yet resolved to more detailed counterparties.
